files.recovery: Offline embedded SourceArt PNG at uasset offset 0x283B through IEND; PNG verification passed; no UE runtime launched
files.runtime: impulse-noise.pack.ts verifies raw grayscale bytes, applies Pow22 source decode and HSV Value exponent 1.2, builds the legacy 8x8 Sharpen4 chain from a separate 2x2 average pyramid with wrapped taps, then packs nine native sRGB RGBA8 mips
files.nativeSampling: Uncompressed sRGB; repeat U/V, linear min/mag and nearest mip selection. The admitted square grid and scalar-radius brush have an isotropic UV footprint, preserving the installed World AnisotropicPoint result without an unsupported anisotropy-plus-point-mip WebGPU sampler. Native World group LOD bias is zero; asset -1 clamps to zero discarded top mips, so all nine levels remain. No extra shader sample bias.
files.materialDefaults: Color / FromTextureAsset / MipValueMode None. Local UV0 * NoiseTiling(1) plus T(0) * PanSpeed(0.5); connected scalar inputs override Panner inline defaults.
files.parity: Known source color/mip/sampler semantics are retained for the admitted brush footprint. Exact UE platform compression and runtime sampled-R pixels are not verified.

files.atlasMapping: slice z -> tile (z % 8, floor(z / 8)); voxel (x,y) within tile; BGRA explicitly exchanged to RGBA
files.runtime: volume-noise.pack.ts reads the verified linear/no-mip/uncompressed atlas by GUID and repacks native RGBA8 128x128x128, one mip; all source B/G/R bytes are equal and alpha is 255

foamRenderTarget.evidence: UE asset defaults plus TextureRenderTarget2D.cpp resource initialization; runtime pixels remain a GPU acceptance gate
foamRenderTarget.r3Owner: Water SLW RenderGraph no-simulation initialization; no static Content replacement
